messages.text:
Our top illuminated floor globe is the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe. It's a large, hand-assembled, made-in-USA heirloom piece with a raised relief antique map that glows to reveal physical terrain when lit, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand — a true centrepiece for a study or living room. If you'd rather have the classic bright blue-ocean look instead of the warm antique tones, the Statesman 20-inch Illuminated Blue Ocean Floor Globe with Walnut Stand has the same illuminated design.

You'll find the Annapolis under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
